situations.translate.importDo: Translator: the button in the import dialog that applies the translation.
situations.translate.importBad: Translator: the error in a dialog when a file cannot be read.
situations.translate.sendTitle: Translator: the title of the dialog before the translation is sent.
situations.translate.sendText: Translator: the text of the dialog before sending; it warns that the GitHub issue is public.
situations.translate.sendGo: Translator: the dialog button that opens GitHub.
situations.translate.issue.new: GitHub issue: the title of a new translation; {name} is the language name, {code} its code.
situations.translate.issue.fix: GitHub issue: the title of a correction; {name} is the language being corrected.
situations.translate.issue.author: GitHub issue: the author line; {name} is the author name.
situations.translate.issue.contact: GitHub issue: the contact line; {contact} is the author contact.
situations.translate.issue.base: GitHub issue: the base language line; {name} is its name.
situations.translate.issue.progress: GitHub issue: the progress line; {n} is the percent, {touched} edited fields, {total} all fields.
situations.translate.issue.attach: GitHub issue: the instruction to attach a file; {file} is the downloaded file name.
situations.translate.issue.changes: GitHub issue: the heading of the list of changes in a language correction.
situations.translate.newTitle: Translator: the title of the dialog for a new language.
situations.translate.name: Translator: the label of the language name field in the new language dialog and the translation details.
situations.translate.code: Translator: the label of the language code field in the new language dialog and the translation details.
situations.translate.codeHint: Translator: a hint below the language code field.
situations.translate.codeBad: Translator: the error below the code field when the code is not valid.
situations.translate.needName: Translator: the error in the new language dialog when the name is missing.
situations.translate.fallback: Translator: the label of the picker for the language shown for untranslated texts.
situations.translate.layout: Translator: the label of the language keyboard picker in the language dialogs and translation details.
situations.translate.create: Translator: the dialog button that creates the language.
situations.translate.cancel: Translator: the Cancel button in all translator dialogs.
situations.translate.editTitle: Translator: the title of the dialog for editing an existing language.
situations.translate.editText: Translator: the explanation in the edit language dialog.
situations.translate.editPick: Translator: the label of the language picker in the edit dialog.
situations.translate.correctionName: Translator: the name of the copy made for a correction; {name} is the name of the edited language.
situations.translate.aboutTitle: Translator: the title of the dialog with the translation details.
situations.translate.author: Translator: the label of the author name field in the translation details.
situations.translate.contact: Translator: the label of the contact field in the translation details.
situations.translate.contactHint: Translator: a hint below the contact field.
situations.translate.delete: Translator: the button in the translation details that deletes the language.
situations.translate.deleteTitle: Translator: the title of the delete confirmation; {name} is the language name.
situations.translate.deleteText: Translator: the text of the confirmation to delete a language.
situations.translate.deleteOk: Translator: the button that confirms deleting the language.
situations.words: Translator: the field where you write all words of the new language, separated by spaces or new lines.
